<a id="ReadsNeverWrite"></a>

### A read never writes

`ReadsNeverWrite` · `src/scenarios.ts:93` · status: **held**

A statement that writes, passed off as a read (made a read by the command maker itself, as nothing else can), goes to the database, which reads it on a connection that refuses to change anything: the database refuses it, and the reservation it would have cancelled is as it was.

**A read never writes · in [Test](infra.md#Test)**
